Self.Wiki: DLC ride jump-off (formerly Locked Mount Jump Fall; the game's CSDlcRideJumpoffRegionIns). The landing or descent area of a sealable DLC spiritspring (see DLC Ride Jump). While it is active, riding Torrent into it gives the rider and Torrent the jump-off SpEffects from GameSystemCommonParam (rideJumpoff_SpEffectIdPc 185 and rideJumpoff_SpEffectId 184 in retail). An SFX can mark it.

SfxID.Wiki: SFX shown at the region. A negative value uses GameSystemCommonParam dlcRideJumpoff_SfxId, which is -1 (no SFX) in retail. Every retail region uses -1.

SfxHeightOffset.Wiki: Height of the SFX above the region's position. 0 or less uses GameSystemCommonParam dlcRideJumpoff_SfxHeightOffset (0 in retail).

EnableEventFlagID.Wiki: The region is active only while this event flag is ON. The game re-checks the flag every frame. 0 or -1: always active. Retail regions use the same flag as their DLC Ride Jump.
